data.description: Acquisition storage and analysis-input policy. Controls canonical waveform formats and optional screenshot capture.

input.description: Waveform source used by analysis. Auto selects available canonical data, preferring verified raw data.
input.title: Waveform source used by analysis

output.description: Waveform format written by acquisition. Raw is preferred for very large captures; both also writes CSV.
output.title: Waveform format written by acquisition

screenshot.description: Oscilloscope screenshot capture. Capture requires a scope and transport that support display transfer.
screenshot.title: Oscilloscope screenshot capture
x-constraints: DHO5108 capture requires TCP/IP or USB-TMC

data.title: Acquisition storage and analysis-input policy

generator.description: Optional function-generator configuration. Required only by commands that trigger or automate a measurement.

connection.description: Function-generator transport URI. The URI selects native GPIB or a Prologix TCP/serial controller.
connection.title: Function-generator transport URI
x-constraints: transport must be supported by the model and build features

model.description: Function-generator driver model. Required when the generator table is present.
model.title: Function-generator driver model
x-constraints: must be a registered generator model

generator.title: Optional function-generator configuration
x-constraints: required by trigger, autoshot, automeasure, and auto

kerr.description: Kerr-angle conversion settings. Specifies the calibration sensor, calculation method, and final factor.

factor.description: Final Kerr-angle conversion factor. Applied after the selected Kerr-angle calculation.
factor.title: Final Kerr-angle conversion factor

method.description: Kerr-angle calculation method. Selects the standard or harmonics-based analysis implementation.
method.title: Kerr-angle calculation method

sensor.description: Sensor channel used for Kerr-angle calibration. The channel must also exist in the sensors array.
sensor.title: Sensor channel used for Kerr-angle calibration

kerr.title: Kerr-angle conversion settings

lockin.description: Numerical lock-in settings. Defines signal channels, parallelism, output stride, and low-pass filtering.

debug_label.description: Safe suffix for debug artifacts. The label is restricted to a short ASCII filename-safe subset.
debug_label.title: Safe suffix for debug artifacts

debug_output.description: Lock-in debug artifact output. Enable only for filter inspection because artifacts can be large.
debug_output.title: Lock-in debug artifact output

debug_overwrite.description: Debug artifact overwrite policy. Allows replacement of an existing matching debug output.
debug_overwrite.title: Debug artifact overwrite policy

filter.description: Lock-in low-pass filter configuration. The current runtime accepts the boxcar_legacy kind; fields from other kinds are not part of schema v5.

half_window_cycles.description: Half-window scale in reference cycles. The boxcar integration window extends symmetrically by this many reference cycles.
half_window_cycles.title: Half-window scale in reference cycles

kind.description: Lock-in filter algorithm. boxcar_legacy is the only active LPF. Historical FIR and IIR kinds are readable only for migration diagnostics.
kind.title: Lock-in filter algorithm

filter.title: Lock-in low-pass filter configuration
x-constraints: fields from other filter kinds are rejected

save_npy.description: NumPy output for lock-in results. Writes NPY artifacts in addition to canonical CSV results.
save_npy.title: NumPy output for lock-in results

signal_channels.description: Channels demodulated by lock-in analysis. At least one channel is required by lock-in and downstream analysis.
signal_channels.title: Channels demodulated by lock-in analysis
x-constraints: must be unique across all channel roles

snr_background_window.description: Optional background window for SNR diagnostics. An inline table with finite start and end values.
snr_background_window.title: Optional background window for SNR diagnostics

snr_signal_window.description: Optional signal window for SNR diagnostics. An inline table with finite start and end values.
snr_signal_window.title: Optional signal window for SNR diagnostics

stride_samples.description: Lock-in output stride in input samples. Input sample rate divided by this value gives the output sample rate.
stride_samples.title: Lock-in output stride in input samples

workers.description: Parallel lock-in worker count. Values near the physical CPU count are a practical starting point.
workers.title: Parallel lock-in worker count

lockin.title: Numerical lock-in settings

phase.description: Phase-rotation settings. Contains offsets for the first six harmonic components.

offsets.description: Six harmonic phase offsets. Numeric expressions such as pi/2 are accepted.
offsets.title: Six harmonic phase offsets

phase.title: Phase-rotation settings

plot.description: Plot generation settings. Controls display/save behavior, decimation, and error policy.

decimation.description: Plot downsampling algorithm. min_max preserves narrow extrema better than stride decimation.
decimation.title: Plot downsampling algorithm

max_points.description: Maximum points passed to plotting. Lower values improve Matplotlib responsiveness on large captures.
max_points.title: Maximum points passed to plotting

mode.description: Plot output mode. Batch use normally selects save; interactive opens Matplotlib windows.
mode.title: Plot output mode

on_error.description: Plot failure policy. Warn preserves successful analysis; fail makes plotting errors fatal.
on_error.title: Plot failure policy

output_dir.description: Deprecated plot directory compatibility field. Version 5 accepts but ignores this field; artifacts use the canonical run layout.
output_dir.title: Deprecated plot directory compatibility field

plot.title: Plot generation settings

pulse.description: Pulse background windows. Defines baseline regions before and after the pulse.

background_after.description: Background window after the pulse. An inline table with finite start and end values.
background_after.title: Background window after the pulse

background_before.description: Background window before the pulse. An inline table with finite start and end values.
background_before.title: Background window before the pulse

pulse.title: Pulse background windows

reference.description: Recorded EOM-drive signal analysis settings. Controls the channel that records the function-generator sine wave sent to the EOM, the FFT region, and fit decimation.

channel.description: Recorded EOM-drive signal channel. The current DHO5108 mapping accepts channels 1 through 8; assign the function-generator sine wave sent to the EOM.
channel.title: Recorded EOM-drive signal channel
x-constraints: must be unique across all channel roles

fft_window.description: Time range used by the EOM-drive FFT. Choose a stable segment of the recorded sine wave with finite start and end values.
fft_window.title: Time range used by the EOM-drive FFT

stride_samples.description: EOM-drive sine-fit decimation stride. Larger values reduce fitting cost at the expense of temporal detail.
stride_samples.title: EOM-drive sine-fit decimation stride

window_samples.description: Local EOM-drive sine-fitting window size. Used around the FFT estimate by EOM-drive signal analysis.
window_samples.title: Local EOM-drive sine-fitting window size

reference.title: Recorded EOM-drive signal analysis settings

scope.description: Oscilloscope configuration. Selects one registered scope model and its transport URI.

connection.description: Oscilloscope transport URI. DHO5108 normally uses direct TCP/IP and never uses a Prologix transport.
connection.title: Oscilloscope transport URI
x-constraints: transport must be supported by the model and build features

model.description: Oscilloscope driver model. The model must match an oscilloscope registered by the instruments crate.
model.title: Oscilloscope driver model
x-constraints: must be a registered oscilloscope model

scope.title: Oscilloscope configuration

sensors.description: Sensor-channel metadata and scaling. Each entry assigns one channel and exactly one scaling strategy.

channel.description: Oscilloscope sensor channel. The current DHO5108 mapping accepts channels 1 through 8.
channel.title: Oscilloscope sensor channel
x-constraints: must be unique across all channel roles

label.description: Plot label for the sensor. Matplotlib mathtext may be supplied as a TOML literal string.
label.title: Plot label for the sensor

scale.description: Sensor conversion rule. Choose direct multiplication or maximum-absolute normalization.

factor.description: Linear sensor conversion factor. Multiplies the integrated sensor values directly.
factor.title: Linear sensor conversion factor

max_abs.description: Target maximum absolute sensor value. Normalizes the measured absolute maximum to this positive target.
max_abs.title: Target maximum absolute sensor value

polarity.description: Polarity for maximum-absolute scaling. Required with max_abs scaling.
polarity.title: Polarity for maximum-absolute scaling

scale.title: Sensor conversion rule
x-constraints: factor and max_abs forms are mutually exclusive

unit.description: Output unit for the scaled sensor. Used in tables, plots, and saved analysis headers.
unit.title: Output unit for the scaled sensor

sensors.title: Sensor-channel metadata and scaling
x-constraints: channels must not overlap reference or lock-in signal channels
